description: With the integrated “valve techniques” the hose can be used to re-inject multiple times if necessary.
whereToUse: Water retaining or excluding structures, water reservoirs, dams, canals, sewage treatment plants
It is suitable for many different structures and construction methods where additional joint security/safety is required.
It can be used as a back-up system for waterstops.
advantages: Multiple re-injections with injection acrylate resins or microfine cement suspensions
One-time injectable with injection polyurethane and epoxy resins
notFor: Concrete surface must be clean and all loose materials removed before installing hose and placing concrete.
it is suggested to keep injection pressures below 600 psi to prevent cross-contamination of adjacent waterstop, when using multiple rows of hose within a single joint
This procedure must be completed within the specified gel time of the material

technicalData.label: Appearance
technicalData.value: Inner core: PVC; Strips: Neoprene based cellular rubber; Mesh: Polyester

technicalData.label: Injection pressure, after the vent end is closed
Hold at the end of injection
technicalData.value: hold the pressure between 500 and 600 psi for approximately 2 more minutes

technicalData.label: Accessories
technicalData.value: All accessories including inlet and outlet PVC-hose are available separately.

packaging: Supplied as a Combi-pack in a cardboard box containing: 200 m YHinjehose, 10 m PVC-hose (inlet), 10 m PVC-hose (outlet), Accessories: 2 m connecting pipe, 4 m heat shrink sleeve, × 50 closure plugs, 1 can of glue, 1 roll of tape, ×800 fastening clips
storage: The product should be stored in ventilated places, with no exposure to sunlight, rain, or fire.
